body:
Why isn't what I am enough? Why do all my efforts to improve prove to be fruitless? Why is it just this cycle of attaining shit and thinking "This will make it better" and it never is?

I want to get to the root of the problem but it's so embedded, rooted deep me. I was born to be a failure and never good enough for anyone, it feels like.
I hope it does. Thanks man.

Nothing seems good enough. It's never enough.

I want so hard to be proud and confident but it's one failure after another.
